title: A New Start at the Community Learning Centre · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Mia is 42 years old. She works in a small shop. Last year, she wanted to learn English. She went to the community learning centre near her home. The centre has evening classes for adults. Mia joined a class in September. She has studied there for eight months. She has already finished two books. She has not taken a test yet. The centre has changed a lot since 2020. In the past, only young people came to the centre. Now, many older adults come too. The centre has opened a new computer room. It has also started free weekend classes. Mia's teacher, Mr. Chen, has worked at the centre since 2015. He says, "Adult learners are very busy. They have families and jobs. But they are also very serious." Mia has made new friends in her class. Her friend, Tom, is 55. He has worked in a factory for thirty years. He has just started learning English.
prompt:
Part 1
Do you like learning new things?
Have you ever taken an evening class?
What do you do in your free time?
Do you prefer studying alone or with friends?

Part 2
Describe a change in your life. You should say: what the change was, when it happened, how you felt about it, and explain why it was important.

Part 3
Why do some adults go back to school?
What are the benefits of learning a new skill?
How has education changed in your country?
Do you think online learning is as good as classroom learning?
